limits.value: The product assumes nodes the customer operates, and the analysis assumes no local hardware, so the first failure is the premise rather than a price.

evidence.proved: 'Expanso runs pipelines on your own nodes, where the data is created'; calls to action are a login and a demo booking, with no published plan

record.notes: Bacalhau, the open-source compute-over-data project this descends from, allowed free job submission to public nodes; that route was not checked and may still exist. A rented small VM plus the open-source agent is the only composition that needs no owned hardware.
